verdicts.reason: A: the product roundel has shrunk to a tiny circle crammed against the top edge, and the bottle is cropped to a dark stub, so the key product image is effectively gone and reads as a glitch; the NEW badge and Try It button stack neatly on the right. B: the bottle is kept and recognisable, but its circle runs into the 't' of 'Sunset' (an unwanted collision), the NEW badge overlaps the top of Try It and is clipped by the canvas edge, and the button crowds the right edge. B is slightly less bad because it keeps the product.
